This chest appears after you kill [[Fronis Irontoe]] in the quest [[Kilroy Stonekin's Punch-Out Extravaganza!]] in [[Fronis Irontoe's Lair]]. In [[normal mode]] you will receive one of the items from the list (two in [[hard mode]]). After you have opened the chest, a countdown timer will appear, and you will be transported back to [[Gunnar's Hold]] in three minutes.
